37837-peter-and-polly-in-winter.title: Peter And Polly In Winter
37837-peter-and-polly-in-winter.creator: Unknown
37837-peter-and-polly-in-winter.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. There are no houses close about it. But there are trees and fields around it. In summer these fields are green. In winter the snow covers them. The fields and the hills are as white as the house. Then there is fun playing in the snow. Peter likes to watch the snowflakes. He calls them "white butterflies." But he knows what they are. His friend, the Story Lady, told him. They are just frozen clouds.

arxiv-2106-09448.title: Minimizing under relaxed symmetry constraints: Triple and N N -junctions.
arxiv-2106-09448.creator: Giorgio Fusco
arxiv-2106-09448.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Giorgio Fusco. We consider a nonnegative potential W : ℝ 2 → ℝ W:\mathbb{R}^{2}\rightarrow\mathbb{R} invariant under the action of the rotation group C N C_{N} of the regular polygon with N N sides, N ≥ 3 N\geq 3 . We assume that W W has N N nondegenerate zeros and prove the existence of a N N -junction solution to the vector Allen-Cahn equation.

arxiv-2207-05763.title: Using wavelets to capture deviations from smoothness in galaxy-scale strong lenses
arxiv-2207-05763.creator: A. Galan ,, G. Vernardos, A. Peel, F. Courbin, J.-L. Starck
arxiv-2207-05763.description: Abstract Modeling the mass distribution of galaxy-scale strong gravitational lenses is a task of increasing difficulty. The high-resolution and depth of imaging data now available render simple analytical forms ineffective at capturing lens structures spanning a large range in spatial scale, mass scale, and morphology. In this work, we address the problem with a novel multiscale method based on wavelets.

arxiv-2301-12863.title: Minimalistic Predictions to Schedule Jobs with Online Precedence Constraints
arxiv-2301-12863.creator: Alexandra Lassota, Alexander Lindermayr, Nicole Megow, Jens Schlöter
arxiv-2301-12863.description: Abstract We consider non-clairvoyant scheduling with online precedence constraints, where an algorithm is oblivious to any job dependencies and learns about a job only if all of its predecessors have been completed. Given strong impossibility results in classical competitive analysis, we investigate the problem in a learning-augmented setting, where an algorithm has access to predictions without any quality guarantee.

arxiv-2310-17097.title: Navigating Data Heterogeneity in Federated Learning: A Semi-Supervised Federated Object Detection
arxiv-2310-17097.creator: Taehyeon Kim, Eric Lin, Junu Lee, Christian Lau, Vaikkunth Mugunthan
arxiv-2310-17097.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a potent framework for training models across distributed data sources while maintaining data privacy. Nevertheless, it faces challenges with limited high-quality labels and non-IID client data, particularly in applications like autonomous driving. To address these hurdles, we navigate the uncharted waters of Semi-Supervised Federated Object Detection (SSFOD).

arxiv-2311-06164.title: Fast and Reliable Reduced-Order Models for Cardiac Electrophysiology
arxiv-2311-06164.creator: Sridhar Chellappa, Barış Cansız, Lihong Feng, Peter Benner, Michael Kaliske
arxiv-2311-06164.description: Abstract Mathematical models of the human heart are increasingly playing a vital role in understanding the working mechanisms of the heart, both under healthy functioning and during disease. The aim is to aid medical practitioners diagnose and treat the many ailments affecting the heart.

arxiv-2406-03894.title: Transductive Off-policy Proximal Policy Optimization
arxiv-2406-03894.creator: Yaozhong GanIndependent Researcheryzgancn@163.comRenye YanPeking Universityvictory@stu.pku.eu.cnXiaoyang TanNanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronauticsx.tan@nuaa.edu.cnZhe WuIndependent Researcherqingshan825@gmail.comJunliang XingTsinghua Universityjlxing@tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2406-03894.description: Abstract Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is a popular model-free reinforcement learning algorithm, esteemed for its simplicity and efficacy. However, due to its inherent on-policy nature, its proficiency in harnessing data from disparate policies is constrained. This paper introduces a novel off-policy extension to the original PPO method, christened Transductive Off-policy PPO (ToPPO).

arxiv-2411-01852.title: Auditing Political Exposure Bias: Algorithmic Amplification on Twitter/ 𝕏 \mathbb{X} During the 2024 U.S. Presidential Election
arxiv-2411-01852.creator: Jinyi Ye, Luca Luceri, Emilio Ferrara
arxiv-2411-01852.description: Abstract . Approximately 50% of tweets in 𝕏 \mathbb{X} ’s user timelines are personalized recommendations from accounts they do not follow. This raises a critical question: What political content are users exposed to beyond their established networks, and what implications does this have for democratic discourse online?

arxiv-2502-12637.title: NRQNN: The Role of Observable Selection in Noise-Resilient Quantum Neural Networks
arxiv-2502-12637.creator: Muhammad Kashif and Muhammad Shafique
arxiv-2502-12637.description: Abstract This paper explores the complexities associated with training Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) under noisy conditions, a critical consideration for Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. We first demonstrate that Barren Plateaus (BPs), characterized by exponetially vanishing gradients, emerge more readily in noisy quantum environments than in ideal conditions.

arxiv-2503-01997.title: The Stochastic Siren: Astrophysical Gravitational-Wave Background Measurements of the Hubble Constant
arxiv-2503-01997.creator: Bryce Cousins, Kristen Schumacher, Adrian Ka-Wai Chung, Colm Talbot, Thomas Callister, Daniel E. Holz, Nicolás Yunes
arxiv-2503-01997.description: Abstract We report the first measurement of the Hubble constant H 0 H_{0} using the stochastic gravitational-wave background arising from binary black hole mergers. This astrophysical background is sensitive to the expansion history of the Universe and thus can be used for cosmological parameter inference independently of not only electromagnetic methods, but also gravitational-wave standard siren approaches.

arxiv-2507-11220.title: κ \kappa -spaces
arxiv-2507-11220.creator: Saak Gabriyelyan, Evgenii Reznichenko
arxiv-2507-11220.description: Abstract We say that a Tychonoff space X X is a κ \kappa -space if it is homeomorphic to a closed subspace of C p ​ ( Y ) C_{p}(Y) for some locally compact space Y Y . The class of κ \kappa -spaces is strictly between the class of Dieudonné complete spaces and the class of μ \mu -spaces.

arxiv-2508-06515.title: BigTokDetect: A Clinically - Informed Vision–Language Modeling Framework for Detecting Pro - Bigorexia Videos on TikTok
arxiv-2508-06515.creator: Minh Duc Chu, Kshitij Pawar, Zihao He, Roxanna Sharifi, Ross Sonnenblick, Magdalayna Curry, Laura D’Adamo, Lindsay Young, Stuart B Murray, Kristina Lerman
arxiv-2508-06515.description: Abstract Social media platforms face escalating challenges in detecting harmful content promoting muscle dysmorphic behaviors and cognitions (bigorexia), which disproportionately affects adolescent males and evades moderation by camouflaging as legitimate fitness advice. We address this challenge with BigTokDetect , a clinically informed framework for identifying pro-bigorexia content on TikTok.

arxiv-2509-26112.title: DNA shotgun sequencing evidence: sample-specific and unknown genotyping error probabilities Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2509-26112.creator: Mikkel Meyer Andersen
arxiv-2509-26112.description: Abstract DNA shotgun sequencing evidence is starting to gain a lot of attraction in forensic genetics. Methods to correctly interpret such evidence, including properly accounting for sequencing errors, are needed. This paper extends the wgsLR model by Andersen et. al.

arxiv-2510-05445.title: AgentRouter: A Knowledge-Graph-Guided LLM Router for Collaborative Multi-Agent Question Answering
arxiv-2510-05445.creator: Zheyuan Zhang, Kaiwen Shi, Zhengqing Yuan, Zehong Wang, Tianyi Ma, Keerthiram Murugesan , Vincent Galassi, Chuxu Zhang, Yanfang Ye
arxiv-2510-05445.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zheyuan Zhang, Kaiwen Shi, Zhengqing Yuan, Zehong Wang, Tianyi Ma, Keerthiram Murugesan , Vincent Galassi, Chuxu Zhang, Yanfang Ye. Large language models (LLMs) and agent-based frameworks have advanced rapidly, enabling diverse applications. Yet, with the proliferation of models and agentic strategies, practitioners face substantial uncertainty in selecting the best configuration for a downstream task. Prior studies show that different agents and backbones exhibit complementary strengths, and that larger models are not always superior, underscoring the need for adaptive routing mechanisms.

arxiv-2510-23423.title: One-arm exponents of the high-dimensional Ising model CNRS and Sorbonne Université, Paris, France, severo@lpsm.paris
arxiv-2510-23423.creator: Diederik van Engelenburg, Christophe Garban, Romain Panis
arxiv-2510-23423.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Diederik van Engelenburg, Christophe Garban, Romain Panis. We study the probability that the origin is connected to the boundary of the box of size n n (the one-arm probability) in several percolation models related to the Ising model.

arxiv-2510-24057.title: VR-Assisted Guide Dog Training: A 360° PanoHaptic System for Right-Hand Commands Analysis
arxiv-2510-24057.creator: Qirong Zhu The University of Tokyo, Ansheng Wang The University of Tokyo, Shinji Tanaka Japan Guide Dog Association, Yasutoshi Makino The University of Tokyo, Hiroyuki Shinoda The University of Tokyo
arxiv-2510-24057.description: Abstract This paper presents a VR-based guide dog training system designed to assist novice trainers in enhancing their understanding of guide dog status and improving issuing appropriate training behavior. Guide dogs play a critical role in supporting independent mobility for visually impaired individuals, but a shortage of skilled trainers limits their availability.

We genetically engineered a unique molecular marker, "fluorescent timer" protein, within our infectious CVB3 clone and...

hermes-pymander-everard-1650.creator: Translated by John Everard
hermes-pymander-everard-1650.description: Everard's 1650 Pymander — the first English Hermetica.

pmc-10518730.title: Ultrasound improves the low-sodium salt curing of sea bass: Insights into the effects of ultrasound on texture, microstructure, and flavor characteristics
pmc-10518730.creator: Hengli Bai, Laihao Li, Yanyan Wu, Shengjun Chen, Yongqiang Zhao, Qiuxing Cai, Yueqi Wang
pmc-10518730.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Highlights•The role and quality impact of ultrasound-assisted fish curing is not yet clear.•Ultrasonic treatment increased the permeation rate and shortened marination time.•Ultrasound treatment reduced the hardness and chewiness of the fish.•Ultrasound-assisted curing improves the quality characteristics of sea bass. Introduction As a common, economically important fish, sea bass is preferred by consumers because of its tender flesh, limited number of spines, and high nutritional value.

pmc-10572767.title: Effects of an Adipose Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Conditioned medium and TGF-β1 on Human Keratinocytes In Vitro
pmc-10572767.creator: Hyrije Ademi, Katarzyna Michalak-Micka, Ueli Moehrlen, Thomas Biedermann, Agnes S Klar, Philip W Wertz, Tae-Kang Kim
pmc-10572767.description: Human keratinocytes play a crucial role during skin wound healing and in skin replacement therapies. The secretome of adipose-derived stem cells (ASCs) has been shown to secrete pro-healing factors, among which include TGF-β1, which is essential for keratinocyte migration and the re-epithelialization of cutaneous wounds during skin wound healing.

pmc-12512983.title: Dual-metal-organic framework and gallic acid incorporated 3D-printed scaffolds: Revolutionizing refractory bone defect repair through immune-angiogenic-neurogenic synergy
pmc-12512983.creator: Yongbo Li, Yifei Guo, Yuanpei Cheng, Xiaodong Liu, Hengren Li, Chen Liu, Xipeng Chen, Heng Yang, Xingzhi Jing, Xiaoyang Liu, Han Wu, Min Guo, Peibiao Zhang, Xingang Cui
pmc-12512983.description: Steroid-associated osteonecrosis (SAON)-related bone defects are refractory and present significant therapeutic challenges due to dysregulated multiple cellular functions and disrupted multidimensional microenvironments. Despite progress in regulating immune responses and promoting vascularization for SAON-related bone defects, effective neural innervation strategies remain limited. Notably, immune response, angiogenesis, and neural innervation are interdependent processes that collectively regulate bone regeneration.

pmc-12534240.title: Practical diagnostic approach to assess myeloid and precursor cell neoplasms on trephine bone marrow biopsies: reflection of middle European reality
pmc-12534240.creator: Thomas Menter, Alexandar Tzankov
pmc-12534240.description: Trephine bone marrow biopsies (TBMB) are standard specimens for diagnostics and follow-up of myeloid and precursor cell neoplasms, usually as part of a multimodal approach including complete blood count (CBC) tests, cytologic assessment of BM aspirate smears, flow cytometry, cytogenomics, and molecular genetics.

pmc-12570594.title: Diseases burden and trends of bladder cancer attributable to behavioral and metabolic factors among global and Chinese population, 1990–2021: results from the global burden of disease study 2021
pmc-12570594.creator: Feifan Liu, Lijun Han, Shuze Liu, Cheng Wang, Jianyu Wang, Shanhua Zhang, Shaoqiu Kong, Xiaoran Han, Haihu Wu, Fei Wu, Jiaju Lyu, Hao Ning
pmc-12570594.description: BackgroundBehavioral and metabolic factors, such as smoking and high fasting plasma glucose (FPG), have been recognized as important risk factors for bladder cancer. This study aims to assess the global and Chinese burden of bladder cancer attributable to these factors and analyze long-term trends.MethodsData from the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 study were used.

pmc-13064694.title: Failure to treat: an American policy perspective
pmc-13064694.creator: Katherine Warburton
pmc-13064694.description: Throughout its two and a half centuries in existence, US mental health policy has repeatedly failed people living with schizophrenia. The failures are cyclical—the inhumane conditions uncovered in the first 75 years of existence were addressed with the construction of state asylums to deliver moral treatment. One hundred years later, the asylums were themselves revealed to be inhumane.

pmc-13098396.title: Case Report: A case of severe infection caused by Clostridium septicum: a literature review
pmc-13098396.creator: Jing Liu, Lu Wang, Yuyun Wang, You Zhang, Yuanqing Qu, Yuan Liu
pmc-13098396.description: Clostridium septicum, an anaerobic spore-forming Gram-positive bacillus, is a rare opportunistic pathogen that causes severe infections with rapid progression and high mortality. Trauma with unmanaged contaminated wounds is a major risk factor, and atypical presentations such as tetanus-like neuromuscular symptoms often lead to misdiagnosis. Herein, we report a 72-year-old male farmer with C.

pmc-13377721.title: Perioperative blood glucose and energy management in gestational diabetes mellitus: a survey of obstetric staff from selected regions in China
pmc-13377721.creator: Xintong Xie, Lizhu Zeng, Xinyan Zhao, Yinge Wang, Xue Lian, Zhifeng Lin, Weizhen Wu
pmc-13377721.description: BackgroundGestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is a common pregnancy-related complication and has been associated with an increased risk of caesarean sections. By surveying obstetric healthcare professionals across Chinese tertiary hospitals, this study examined the current state of blood glucose and energy management during the perioperative period of women with GDM scheduled for caesarean section.

pmc-13403176.title: A Model for Implementing Psychotherapy for Individuals With Cognitive Impairments
pmc-13403176.creator: Adrienne L Johnson, Mary F Wyman, Megan Gjertsen, Samantha Shapiro, Sheniqua Bouges, Jonathan Singer, Nathanial Chin
pmc-13403176.description: Objectives:Individuals with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and Alzheimer’s disease and Alzheimer’s disease–related dementias (AD/ADRD) are at greater risk for mental health concerns than those without cognitive impairments. We report the implementation of psychological services for patients with MCI and mild AD/ADRD within a large public health-care system in the United States.Methods:Preimplementation process included identifying a clinic champion.

pmc-13591213.title: Community‐Based Outpatient Therapeutic Program Implementation in Central Gondar Zone, Northwest Ethiopia: A Process Evaluation Using Access and Implementation Fidelity Frameworks
pmc-13591213.creator: Chalie Tadie Tsehay, Ayal Debie, Getnet Mitike Kassie, Eskedar Getie Mekonnen, Wubet Worku Takele, Ashenafi Tazebew Amare, Amare Demsie Ayele, Tsegaye G. Haile
pmc-13591213.description: Children with severe acute malnutrition have a 10‐fold increased risk of death, diminished intellectual development and poor adult work capacity. Community‐based outpatient therapeutic programs are among the key interventions designed to manage uncomplicated severe acute malnutrition at the community level in Ethiopia.

pmc-13663235.title: A novel nanosensor for in situ detection of EV-miR-107 enables noninvasive tuberculosis diagnosis and treatment monitoring
pmc-13663235.creator: Yuan Wu, Shihua Luo, jin Gu, Wei Xu, Min Yang, Jiayu Zhou, Xiaosai Ma, Chonghai Qiu, Muru Xu, Guixian Huang, Liying Zhu, Xunjia Cheng, Hongbo Shen, Qiliang Cai, Feifei Wang
pmc-13663235.description: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a leading cause of infectious death globally, creating an urgent need for rapid and non-invasive diagnostics. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) have emerged as promising carriers of disease-specific microRNAs with biomarker potential. This study identifies EV-miR-107 as a candidate host-response biomarker for TB, showing significant upregulation in TB patient plasma and a murine BCG infection model.
